project.name: TealHelix: Common DAO utilities
project.description:
Common DAO-related functionalities, assuming a JPA reactive implementation.
It would be nice to keep this module independent of any underlying persistence implementation, so that we can plug implementations at will. However, wrapping the entire Criteria API was beyond the scope of this implementation, so the implementation classes leak. Maybe we could replace the Criteria API with a more neutral implementation (QueryDSL???), but that is out of scope for the moment too.
Or we could give an implementation-aware component access to the underlying implementation-specific objects with a mechanism similar to EntityManager.unwrap().
